text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The buzz surrounding the clash with Taiki 
Shuttle in the Yasuda Kinen drew massive 
crowds to Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Watching Hishi Akebono race really gives 
you energy! You can't take your eyes off 
such a dynamic race that puts her big 
build to work." Praise like this filled 
the entire venue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono resolved to gauge her future 
in the Sprinters Stakes. With an unusually 
serious look in her eyes, she entered the 
starting gate.
